datasets.name: genie_agents_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  u.sku_name,
  CASE
    WHEN sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 'Free'
    ELSE 'Paid'
  END AS usage_type,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
    ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  u.usage_date,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  u.sku_name
ORDER BY
  u.usage_date

queryLines:
SELECT

    WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 'Free'

  END AS usage_type,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default ELSE 0 END) AS cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w

    ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
    AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
    AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  u.usage_date,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  u.sku_name
ORDER BY
  u.usage_date

datasets.name: user_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_one_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_one_cost,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_agents_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_agents_cost,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_paid_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
        AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS genie_code_paid_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  u.identity_metadata.run_as
ORDER BY
  genie_code_paid_cost DESC

WITH free_usage AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    usage_quantity,
    usage_end_time
  FROM
    system.billing.usage
  WHERE
    billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
    AND sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
    AND usage_date >= :date_range.min
    AND usage_date <= :date_range.max
),
latest_real_sku AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    max_by(sku_name, usage_start_time) AS proxy_sku_name

    system.billing.usage
  WHERE
    billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
    AND usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id
)

    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp

      AND f.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time

        lp.price_end_time IS NULL

datasets.name: spending_percentiles
queryLines:
SELECT
  stack(
    6,
    'P25',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.25),
    'P50 (Median)',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.50),
    'P75',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.75),
    'P90',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.90),
    'P95',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.95),
    'P99',
    PERCENTILE(genie_code_paid_cost, 0.99)
  ) AS (percentile, value_usd)
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_CODE'
            AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
          THEN
            u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) AS genie_code_paid_cost
    FROM
      system.billing.usage u
        LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
          ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
          AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
          AND (
            lp.price_end_time IS NULL
            OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time
          )
    WHERE
      u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
      AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
    GROUP BY
      u.identity_metadata.run_as

datasets.name: genie_one_top_users
queryLines:
WITH free_dbus AS (
  SELECT
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS free_dbus
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
    AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
    AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
    AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    u.identity_metadata.run_as
  ORDER BY
    free_dbus DESC
  LIMIT 50
),
cost_users AS (
  SELECT
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_ONE'
    AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
    AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
    AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    u.identity_metadata.run_as
  ORDER BY
    cost DESC
  LIMIT 60
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(f.user, c.user) AS user,
  COALESCE(f.free_dbus, 0) AS free_dbus,
  COALESCE(c.cost, 0) AS cost
FROM
  free_dbus f
    FULL OUTER JOIN cost_users c
      ON f.user = c.user
ORDER BY
  cost DESC,
  free_dbus DESC

datasets.name: genie_agents_by_agent_id
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id AS agent_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS free_dbus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS paid_dbus,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.identity_metadata.run_as) AS unique_users
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'

  AND u.usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND u.usage_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id,
  w.workspace_name
ORDER BY
  (free_dbus + paid_dbus) DESC
LIMIT 20

This dashboard provides analytics on Genie paid and free usage consumption based on `system.billing.usage`. By default it is set to the current month, but a custom date range can be applied using the **Date Range** global filter.

*Note: System tables can have a lag of a few hours; so #s will not match Budgets UI refreshes much more quickly.*

1. Free usage is only available from 07/20/26 onwards
2. Until 01/31/27, Genie One and Genie Agents is free (except for service principals)
